events.title: Coloplast names former J&J executive Gavin Wood as CEO
events.body: Wood spent 20 years at J&J, culminating in a spell as company group chairman for the medtech business in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

events.title: Coloplast AS (CLPBF) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Strong Organic Growth Amid Market Challenges
events.body: Coloplast AS (CLPBF) reports a 6% organic revenue growth and maintains a positive outlook despite facing disruptions in key markets.
